features.method: Both colours; four-connected interior source regions with a solid core. At least 60% of each region must remain its original colour. Regions touching the border or its one-pixel neighbourhood, and tiny or thin classification fragments, are excluded. All observed pixels still enter the image-error measurement.

native.meaning: Sparse assistant-reviewed photo samples, not complete pixel accuracy or cutting-path truth. Cropped-out and unavailable samples remain in the denominator.

qualifications: Each pixel/crop combination has a different target; compare methods within one fixed target.

Short timed probes are retained and show cold runtime sensitivity; the first loaded-kernel 700 ms probe failed the source-error gate.
